info.name: MEME · CCUS
info.description: CCUS models on MEME's adopt-net0 target. "AdOpT CO2 network" is the full model (capture sources, Bremen hub, CO2 storage sinks, pipeline and railway routes); it needs the MEME build with AdOpT network support (rc-testing-adoptnet0 working tree; until the VM is updated, point base_url at a local MEME, e.g. http://localhost:18080). "AdOpT copperplate" runs on the current VM but has no routes. Run Simulate, poll status until state = succeeded; the result contract is at runs[0].contract.
